observations: Plum knitted cuffs frame both hands.
Gold scissors sit beside the circular woven mat.

copy.title: Tying a Ribbon Around a Book Gift
copy.alt: Hands in plum sleeves tie a red, black and green ribbon around a wrapped book on a woven mat, with gold scissors beside it.
copy.description: A bow forms over a cream-wrapped book, whose page edges remain visible beneath the paper. Plum knitted cuffs and a pair of gold scissors frame this close view of gift wrapping.

observations: The complete oval table and all its legs are visible.
The tabletop includes separate bowls and a carved goblet.

copy.title: Kwanzaa Meal Table
copy.alt: An oval wooden table holds bowls of rice, greens and beans, cornbread and vegetables over a red, black and green runner.
copy.description: Bowls and serving platters fill an oval table supported by turned wooden legs. A striped runner passes beneath the food, and a carved goblet stands near the cornbread.

observations: Both standing figures have complete legs and shoes.
Vegetable baskets fill the lower kitchen shelves.

copy.title: Preparing Greens Together
copy.alt: Two cooks prepare a shared meal at a wooden kitchen unit, one stirring a red pot while the other holds a bowl of greens.
copy.description: A cook in a teal apron stirs a red pot while a second cook in a rust blouse tears greens into a wooden bowl. Vegetable baskets and a closed pot occupy the shelves below their worktop.

observations: The spoon rests across the bowl rim.
Red and pale pieces are mixed into the dark greens.

copy.title: Leafy Greens with a Wooden Serving Spoon
copy.alt: A cream ceramic bowl of leafy greens and small vegetable pieces rests on a striped cloth, with a wooden spoon across the rim.
copy.description: Dark folded greens fill a softly rounded cream bowl, dotted with red and pale vegetable pieces. A wooden spoon stretches across the rim above the red, black and green cloth.

observations: The pale beans have dark eye-like markings.
A separate cornbread square sits on the wooden board.

copy.title: Black-Eyed Peas and Cornbread
copy.alt: A blue pottery bowl of black-eyed peas sits beside a golden cornbread square on a wooden board and striped cloth.
copy.description: Small pale beans with dark markings fill a blue pottery bowl. A thick square of golden cornbread sits alongside it on a wooden serving board, with striped fabric beneath.

observations: Wooden utensils lie on both sides of the cream plate.
A dried multicolored corn ear rests near the cloth.

copy.title: Plate and Corn on a Woven Place Mat
copy.alt: An overhead place setting includes a cream plate, wooden utensils, a carved cup, folded striped cloth and an ear of corn.
copy.description: A cream plate anchors this overhead arrangement on a round woven mat. Wooden cutlery, a carved cup and folded red, black and green fabric surround it, with dried corn at the edge.

observations: The wooden box has three seed compartments.
Blank kraft envelopes sit beside the tied notebook.

copy.title: Seed Box with a Ribbon-Tied Notebook
copy.alt: A divided wooden box holds corn kernels, speckled beans and pale seeds beside kraft envelopes and a tied cream notebook.
copy.description: Three wooden compartments separate yellow kernels, speckled beans and pale seeds. Blank envelopes and a cream notebook tied with red, black and green cord complete the small seed-saving gift.

observations: Three differently dressed arms converge at the stacked hands.
The lower cloth has red, black and green bands.

copy.title: Three Hands Joined Above a Woven Cloth
copy.alt: Three adult hands with cream, teal and rust-patterned cuffs overlap above a small red, black and green woven cloth.
copy.description: Three differently dressed arms meet in a stack of hands. Cream fabric, teal sleeves and a rust-patterned cuff provide distinct textures above a small striped woven cloth.

observations: The drum narrows through the middle and widens at its base.
A full carrying strap curves along the right side.

copy.title: Rope-Laced Wooden Hand Drum
copy.alt: A wooden goblet-shaped drum has a pale drumhead, red, black and green lacing and a striped carrying strap.
copy.description: Rope lacing runs from a pale drumhead down the tapered wooden body. Carved geometric details mark the lower section, while a striped strap curves beside the complete drum.

observations: Three complete seated figures wear different outfits.
The instruments include a tall drum, shaker and frame drum.

copy.title: Three Seated Percussion Players
copy.alt: Three seated musicians play a goblet drum, a round shaker and a frame drum beneath red, black and green pennants.
copy.description: A woman in a mustard dress plays a tall hand drum beside a gray-bearded musician holding a round shaker. A younger player in plum completes the group with a frame drum; each sits on a separate stool.

observations: The reader has long locs and a navy skirt.
A microphone angles above the complete wooden lectern.

copy.title: Reading Behind a Cloth-Draped Lectern
copy.alt: A woman with long locs reads an open book behind a wooden lectern draped with striped cloth and fitted with a microphone.
copy.description: An open book rests in the reader’s hands above a wooden lectern. Her cream blouse and long navy skirt contrast with the red, black and green drape, while an angled microphone points toward her.

observations: The dancer wears a high coiled bun and black flats.
The striped sash extends to the right of the rust skirt.

copy.title: Dancer with a Flowing Striped Sash
copy.alt: A dancer in a teal top and flowing rust skirt extends her arms as a red, black and green sash trails beside her.
copy.description: A long rust skirt sweeps around the dancer’s legs beneath a fitted teal top. Her raised arms and trailing striped sash create a wide, open silhouette, with black flats visible below the hem.

observations: The cloth stack includes cream, mustard and navy layers.
Fringed woven edges remain visible beneath the diagonal fabric.

copy.title: Folded Woven Cloths with Striped Edges
copy.alt: Folded cream, mustard and navy woven cloths form a stack crossed by red, black and green fabric with fringed edges.
copy.description: Woven textures and short fringes distinguish the folded cloths in this compact stack. Cream, mustard and navy layers sit beneath a broad diagonal band of red, black and green fabric.

observations: The open wooden door has a striped ribbon.
The three complete figures wear a cardigan, long coat and dungarees.

copy.title: Greeting Visitors at a Ribbon-Decorated Door
copy.alt: A gray-haired man greets a woman in a sage coat and a child in navy dungarees beside an open wooden door.
copy.description: An open wooden door carries a small striped ribbon as three people exchange a greeting. The visitor’s long sage coat and shoulder bag contrast with the older man’s rust cardigan and the child’s navy dungarees.

observations: One volunteer holds a grabber and green collection bag.
The kneeling volunteer reaches toward a crumpled piece of paper.

copy.title: Working Together in a Community Garden
copy.alt: Two volunteers collect litter near a garden border, using a grabber and green bag beside a wooden notice frame.
copy.description: A silver-haired volunteer in blue work clothes holds a litter grabber beside a green bag. A second volunteer kneels to pick up paper near the planting border, with a plain wooden notice frame behind them.

observations: The working basket has a red, black and green rim.
Loose reeds and a second finished basket flank the stool.

copy.title: Weaving a Basket with a Striped Rim
copy.alt: A seated woman with long braids weaves a basket with a red, black and green rim beside loose reeds and a finished basket.
copy.description: Long reeds extend from the basket taking shape in the weaver’s lap. She sits on a wooden stool in a plum top and ochre trousers, with a reed bundle on one side and a finished basket on the other.

observations: The younger helper supports the horizontal backrest slat.
The older man holds his screwdriver clear of the wood.

copy.title: Repairing a Wooden Park Bench Together
copy.alt: Two people support a wooden bench slat while an older man holds a screwdriver, with a striped tool roll beside the bench.
copy.description: A young helper in sage overalls supports a wooden backrest slat beside an older man with glasses and gray hair. His screwdriver is raised clear of the wood, and a red, black and green tool roll lies nearby.

observations: The older woman, rather than the child, holds the recorder.
The listener rests her chin on one hand across the round table.

copy.title: Recording a Story at the Table
copy.alt: A silver-haired woman holds a handheld recorder while a girl listens across a round wooden table with an open notebook.
copy.description: The older storyteller gestures with one hand and holds a small recorder in the other. Across the round table, a girl in a mustard sweater listens with her chin resting on her hand beside a blank notebook.

observations: A trailing plant rests on top of the complete bookshelf.
The child sorts books on the floor beside the standing adult.

copy.title: Arranging a Shared Bookshelf
copy.alt: An adult in rust overalls arranges books while a child in a teal hoodie sorts another stack beside a wooden shelf.
copy.description: Books fill a freestanding wooden shelf topped by a trailing plant. An adult reaches toward its rows while a seated child sorts a stack below, beside a woven basket and a strip of colored fabric.

observations: The closed book has a green cover.
A partly beaded tassel extends beside a bowl of loose beads.

copy.title: Beaded Bookmark Beside a Closed Book
copy.alt: A green hardcover book sits beside a bowl of red, black and green beads, a cord spool and a partly beaded bookmark.
copy.description: A tasseled bookmark stretches across the foreground beside its remaining beads and cord. The closed green book adds a solid rectangular shape behind the small round beads and coiled spool.

observations: The woven paper alternates red, black, green and tan strips.
A wooden ruler and red scissors sit beside the spare strips.

copy.title: Paper-Weaving Mat and Craft Tools
copy.alt: A red, black, green and tan woven paper mat is surrounded by loose strips, a wooden ruler and red scissors.
copy.description: Alternating paper strips form a small rectangular woven mat. Spare lengths remain beside it, with a marked wooden ruler and red scissors arranged as a compact set of craft materials.

observations: Rope remains visible between the colored fabric bands.
A miniature open book is mounted at the bottom of the wreath.

copy.title: Cloth-Wrapped Wreath with an Open Book
copy.alt: A rope wreath wrapped in red, black and green fabric carries a small open book and bow at its lower edge.
copy.description: Natural rope remains visible between bands of striped and geometric fabric around the circular wreath. A miniature open book rests at the bottom above a tied bow, balancing the otherwise open center.

observations: The central cream invitation panel contains no writing.
The lower corner shows corn and a wooden cup.

copy.title: Blank Invitation with Corn and a Wooden Cup
copy.alt: A cream invitation card with a red, black and green border shows corn and a wooden cup above an ochre envelope.
copy.description: A broad empty cream panel leaves the center of this invitation clear. Corn and a wooden cup decorate the lower corner, while an ochre envelope sits behind the card’s striped border.

observations: The three tags carry different object illustrations.
A twine spool and pencil lie alongside the tags.

copy.title: Illustrated Gift Tags and Twine
copy.alt: Three kraft gift tags show books, a woven circle and corn beside a twine spool, pencil and colored paper.
copy.description: Small subject drawings distinguish the three kraft-colored tags: books, a woven circle and corn. Loose twine curves around the group, with a spool, pencil and red, black and green paper behind it.

observations: Both seated figures and their complete stools are visible.
The woven strands are held within a freestanding wooden frame.

copy.title: Weaving Lesson at a Wooden Loom
copy.alt: Black-and-white line art shows an older man with glasses and a teenager working together at a complete wooden loom.
copy.description: An older weaver and a teenager sit beside a freestanding wooden loom, their hands meeting the strands across its frame. Clear black outlines define their clothes, stools and the full loom without colored accents.

observations: The server holds a ladle above the supported pot.
The man with locs and a beard carries a plate beside the table.

copy.title: Serving a Meal at a Buffet Table
copy.alt: Black-and-white line art shows a woman ladling food from a pot while a man holds a plate beside a cloth-covered table.
copy.description: A woman with a braided bun lifts a ladle above a supported pot as a bearded man waits with a plate. Bowls, a cup and the draped buffet table complete the outlined meal-serving scene.

observations: The tree carries blank portrait silhouettes rather than written names.
Glue and scissors rest on the complete round craft table.

copy.title: Adding Portraits to a Family Tree Craft
copy.alt: Two children add blank portrait shapes to a tabletop tree, with paper, glue and scissors on the round craft table.
copy.description: A branching cardboard tree rises from the center of a round table as two children arrange portrait-shaped pieces on it. Glue, paper and scissors sit around the base, all drawn in neutral black outlines.

observations: The seated child has cornrow braids and striped sleeves.
The kneeling older boy wears rectangular glasses and a cardigan.

copy.title: Opening a Book Gift Beside a Rocking Chair
copy.alt: A child with cornrow braids opens a book gift in a rocking chair while an older boy with glasses kneels alongside.
copy.description: The child lifts a blank book from an open gift box while seated in a wooden rocking chair. A glasses-wearing older boy kneels beside the chair, with discarded ribbon spread across the woven mat beneath them.

observations: The seated older listener wears a cap and holds a cane.
A separate pole carries a banded cloth beside the standing reader.

copy.title: Listening to a Reading Beside a Garden Bench
copy.alt: An older man in a cap sits with a cane beside a standing teenager reading from a booklet, in black-and-white line art.
copy.description: The seated listener turns toward a teenager holding an open booklet beside the bench. A cane rests near his hand, and a small freestanding pole with a banded cloth completes the outlined scene.

observations: Both adults support the same wide produce basket.
The complete scene includes a wooden gate and surrounding plants.

copy.title: Carrying Produce Through a Garden Gate
copy.alt: Two adults carry a wide vegetable basket through a wooden garden gate surrounded by plants, in black-and-white line art.
copy.description: A bearded man and a woman in a headwrap support opposite sides of a wide produce basket. Corn and leafy vegetables rise above its rim as they pass through the open wooden gate among garden plants.
